status: Final-data retraining implementation; full five-seed metrics require a new experiment
model_math: Single 21-channel TextCNN / DGL GIN / multimodal cross-attention reference model; new training required
coordinate_protocol: Seeded RDKit conformers from final-data SMILES. Add independent Gaussian noise (0.02 angstrom) to real heavy-atom coordinates immediately before the frozen Uni-Mol2 forward pass during training. Use clean conformers at validation and test. Protein graphs and sequence-only ESM-2 embeddings use their fixed release inputs.
trainable_scope: Train TextCNN, both GINs, projection layers, fusion and classifier. Freeze MoLFormer, Uni-Mol2 and ESM-2.
historical_comparison: Archived test probabilities from a different data version reproduce Table S2 means. They are not predictions from this implementation.
split_origin: Reconstructed from the exact final-data Release parent groups; not asserted to be historical experiment fold IDs

reference_interpretation.intra_attention: self-attention over the three modalities within each entity
reference_interpretation.cross_attention: each entity queries the other two; the molecule row implements molecule Q versus both protein K,V
reference_interpretation.contrastive: sum over molecule-to-protein positive pairs; denominator contains all other final entity embeddings in the batch
